query.meaning: One of the candidate set queries that found the source

title.meaning: Source title or local file name

char_start.meaning: Excerpt start in decoded source, code points

char_end.meaning: Excerpt end, exclusive. Greater than char_start

excerpt.meaning: Verbatim source text from char_start to char_end

excerpt_sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 excerpt bytes

citation_ids.meaning: Citation IDs in this set that support the idea

risks.meaning: Known ways the idea could fail

compute_alignment.meaning: Compute alignment score using rubric anchors

novelty_reason.meaning: One-sentence reason for the novelty score

feasibility_reason.meaning: One-sentence reason for the feasibility score

compute_alignment_reason.meaning: One-sentence reason for the compute alignment score

citation_ids.meaning: Evidence behind the scores. Subset of the idea's citations

dependency_flags.meaning: Forbidden dependency IDs that apply. May be empty

eligible.meaning: False exactly when dependency_flags is not empty

rank.meaning: Position, counting up from 1 without gaps

idea_id.meaning: Ranked idea with disposition selected or eligible

producer_node.meaning: Node that will produce the value. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; an existing node ID other than the consumer.

port.meaning: Output port of that node. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; a name in the producer node outputs.

artifact_type.meaning: Artifact type the consumer expects. A mismatch is an incompatible binding. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; must equal the producer output artifact_type.

node_id.meaning: Name of this node in the graph, for example `screening`. Never reused. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique in the plan.

cc.meaning: The one CC version this node runs. M1 binds one CC per node. Constraint: must match one library entry with selectable_by_planner true.

objective.meaning: One plain sentence on what this node does for the run. Constraint: 1 to 300 characters.

requirement_ids.meaning: Mandatory Brief requirements this node helps satisfy. Constraint: each an ID in the Brief mandatory_requirements; at most 40.

deliverable_ids.meaning: Brief deliverables this node produces or helps produce. Constraint: each an ID in the Brief deliverables; at most 20; requirement_ids and deliverable_ids together hold at least 1 item.

predecessors.meaning: Nodes that must be accepted before this node starts. Extra entries are ordering-only dependencies. Constraint: node IDs; at most 11; includes every future.producer_node of this node; no self reference.

inputs.meaning: Typed bindings for the node inputs. Constraint: at most 16 items; covers every required library input port.

outputs.meaning: Typed outputs the node will produce. Constraint: 1 to 16 items; covers every required library output port.

limits.meaning: Time, model-call and memory ceiling for one attempt of this node. Constraint: each value at most the library max_limits.

suggested_checks.meaning: Extra deterministic checks the Planner wants. The binder may adopt them. They never replace the mandatory bundle. Constraint: at most 8 check IDs, each matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$.

split.meaning: loop or final partition identity, not case IDs

operand.meaning: The treatment aggregate is what gets compared

reference.meaning: What the treatment aggregate is compared with

factor.meaning: Multiplier on the baseline aggregate. 0 for constant, greater than 0 for baseline (cross-field rule checked in output_structure)

offset.meaning: Added after the factor, in the metric unit

reason.meaning: Actionable observed basis; no secret values

cost_amount.meaning: Reported attributable cost, or unavailable; no fabricated estimate

unavailable_reasons.meaning: Unsupported or unobserved fields and basis

name.meaning: Consumer input port name. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique in the node; an input port of the CC in the library entry.

artifact_type.meaning: Artifact type of the port. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; equals the library input port type.

required.meaning: Whether the node needs this input. The Planner cannot mark a required library port optional. Constraint: must be true when the library port is required.

source_kind.meaning: `accepted_ref` means an input that exists when the run starts (the Brief, the bound search scope or a supplied resource). `future_output` means the accepted output of an earlier node. `host_record` means a record the host supplies without a producing node. Constraint: enum.

run_input_key.meaning: Which run input or host record to bind. The Planner names the key and never writes a ref. Constraint: non-null exactly when source_kind is accepted_ref or host_record. For accepted_ref the value is brief, search_scope or a resource_key of the resource inventory. For host_record the value is screening_rubric, build_receipt or gate_decision_index.

accepted_ref.meaning: Exact bytes of the run input. Only the binder fills this field. Constraint: null in every plan proposal and static template. In a run plan non-null when source_kind is accepted_ref and null otherwise (a host record is bound at dispatch).

future.meaning: Producer node, port and type of the future value. It binds to the gate-accepted output only, at dispatch. Constraint: non-null exactly when source_kind is future_output.

name.meaning: Producer output port name. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique in the node; an output port of the CC in the library entry.

artifact_type.meaning: Artifact type of the port. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; equals the library output port type.

required.meaning: Whether the node must produce this output. Constraint: must be true when the library port is required.

depends_on.meaning: Earlier internal subnode IDs; protected gates mediate work dependencies

template_ref.meaning: Frozen internal port and checking template

subject_subnode_id.meaning: Submitted work subject; final assignment aggregates node obligations

profile_ref.meaning: Independently owned criteria and checking profile

status.meaning: pass or deferred; unavailable/unknown mandatory checks block

snapshot_ref.meaning: Immutable initial protected ledger snapshot; live recheck is separate

node_remaining.meaning: Remaining node time/calls and effective memory ceiling

routing_reserved.meaning: Routing overhead reservation, included in node totals

tokens_remaining.meaning: Available attributable token balance or unavailable

other_work_reserved.meaning: Reserved other required work; not available to this invocation

role.meaning: Protected attribution label; not Router executor type

admission_ref.meaning: Pinned admission decision; current standing rechecked

invocation_limits.meaning: Existing chosen binding limits; CC execution scope

node_limits.meaning: Parent aggregate limits including routing and verification

budget_snapshot.meaning: Protected independent reservations and available balance

native_structured_output.meaning: Explicit native generation requirement, never inferred from JSON ports

model_allowlist.meaning: Optional narrowing; explicit empty list denies all

quality.meaning: Soft quality preference with evidence basis

enabled.meaning: Protected authorization for an internal selection call

deployment_ref.meaning: Pinned approved Judge; required when enabled

model_calls.meaning: Zero when disabled; at most one when enabled

output_tokens.meaning: Bounded billed output including reported reasoning

disclosure_scope.meaning: Permitted bounded Judge material; no credentials

time_s.meaning: Nonnegative remaining/reserved elapsed allowance; zero is exhausted or inapplicable

memory_mb.meaning: Positive effective resource ceiling; not additive spend

aggregation.meaning: How repeats combine into value. Equals the blueprint aggregation

delta.meaning: Treatment minus baseline value. Non-null exactly when both values are non-null

repeats.meaning: Raw value of each completed repeat in order. Length equals repeat_count when value is non-null

value.meaning: Registered aggregate of repeats. Null exactly when unmeasured_reason is non-null

unmeasured_reason.meaning: Why no value exists. Null or one of the enum values

repeat_index.meaning: Repeat number within the role, below repeat_count

seed.meaning: Equals blueprint seed for every run (fixed_same_for_all_runs)

subject_ref.meaning: Baseline: blueprint baseline_identity.resource_ref. Treatment: manifest archive_ref

gpu_model.meaning: GPU name. Non-null when gpu_count above 0

gpu_memory_mb.meaning: Memory per GPU. Non-null when gpu_count above 0

captured_at.meaning: UTC ISO 8601, before the first started_at

hash_verified.meaning: Must be true when the lock carries a hash

metric_id.meaning: Equals a blueprint metric_id, unique across findings

threshold.meaning: Non-null exactly when rule_applied is success, falsification or conditional

status.meaning: incomplete exactly when a metric side is unmeasured

notes.meaning: Notes. At least one when status is not plausible

path.meaning: Confined lowercase relative path, unique in manifest

artifact_ref.meaning: Exact content identity; sha256 equals file bytes

resource_ref.meaning: Baseline resource snapshot, one of resource_refs

revision.meaning: Captured immutable revision, equals the snapshot revision

entry_point.meaning: File in the snapshot that Benchmark runs as the baseline

measurement.meaning: Deterministic definition of one repeat value

aggregation.meaning: How repeats combine into one aggregate per arm

target_id.meaning: Brief target_metrics id this metric measures, or null

falsification.meaning: Registered falsification region, disjoint from success

middle.meaning: Classification for results in neither region

conditional_rule.meaning: Registered condition for conditional acceptance. Not null exactly when middle is CONDITIONALLY_ACCEPTABLE

conditional_meaning.meaning: Plain meaning of conditional acceptance. Not null exactly when conditional_rule is not null

must_not_change.meaning: Immutable items. Must contain baseline, validation_data, measurement_functions, outcome_rules

version.meaning: One exact version, no range or marker

syntax_result.meaning: Compile result. not_applicable only for requirements.txt

syntax_detail.meaning: Compiler message, not null when fail

forbidden_imports.meaning: Forbidden modules or dynamic import uses found

cc_name.meaning: Dotted name of the capability capsule. It must equal the name of an entry in the library snapshot. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$, for example research.screening.

cc_version.meaning: Admitted version of that CC. Together with `cc_name` it must match exactly one library snapshot entry. Never a range or `latest`. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,31}$.

declaration_sha256.meaning: Digest of the exact declaration bytes. In a plan proposal or static template it must equal the digest in the library entry. The binder rejects a mismatch. Constraint: 64 lowercase hex characters.

check_bundle_id.meaning: The `bundle_id` of the pinned check_bundle record (lowercase dotted snake_case, for example research.screening.checks). Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*$.

check_bundle_version.meaning: The `version` of the pinned check_bundle record. Constraint: pattern ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$.

check_bundle_sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of the exact check_bundle record bytes. Constraint: 64 lowercase hex characters.

checking_profile_id.meaning: The `profile_id` of the pinned checking_profile record (lowercase dotted snake_case, for example research.screening.profile). Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*$.

checking_profile_version.meaning: The `version` of the pinned checking_profile record. Constraint: pattern ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$.

checking_profile_sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of the exact checking_profile record bytes. Constraint: 64 lowercase hex characters.

name.meaning: Port name exactly as in the CC declaration. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique among the same direction of one entry.

artifact_type.meaning: Lowercase snake_case artifact type that flows through the port, for example `candidate_set`. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$.

schema_ref.meaning: Exact contract that defines the port content. Two ports are compatible only when both `artifact_type` and `schema_ref` are equal. Constraint: schema URN or field-contract ID.

required.meaning: True when the CC cannot run without this input, or must produce this output.

resource_key.meaning: Key of a resource the CC reads or uses, as in the declaration `needs.resources`. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$.

mode.meaning: How the CC uses the resource. Constraint: enum. `exclusive` means no other node may use the resource during the attempt (for example one GPU).

min_quantity.meaning: Smallest quantity needed (for example one GPU). Null when the resource is not countable. Constraint: null or at least 1.

cc_name.meaning: Dotted name of the capability capsule. It must equal the name of an entry in the library snapshot. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$, for example research.screening.

cc_version.meaning: Admitted version of that CC. Together with `cc_name` it must match exactly one library snapshot entry. Never a range or `latest`. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,31}$.

declaration_sha256.meaning: Digest of the exact declaration bytes. In a plan proposal or static template it must equal the digest in the library entry. The binder rejects a mismatch. Constraint: 64 lowercase hex characters.

selectable_by_planner.meaning: True when the Planner may choose this CC. False for fixed preparation CCs (Intent, Requirement) and for the Planner itself. The static template may use any entry marked true.

input_ports.meaning: All input ports declared by the CC. Constraint: at most 16 items; names unique.

output_ports.meaning: All output ports declared by the CC. Constraint: 1 to 16 items; names unique.

effect_class.meaning: Effect class from the CC declaration `changes.effect_class`. Constraint: enum.

network_mode.meaning: Network mode from the declaration `needs.network.mode`. Constraint: enum.

resource_needs.meaning: Resources the CC needs, taken from the declaration. Constraint: at most 16 items.

max_limits.meaning: Per-node ceiling taken from the declaration budget. A node may ask for less, never more. Constraint: all values positive except model_calls, which may be 0.

check_pins.meaning: Check bundle and checking profile pinned by protected admission. Null means the version has no admitted bundle. The binder must reject any node that uses a null entry. Constraint: must be non-null for a usable entry.

resource_key.meaning: Key that CC declarations use to ask for this resource. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique in the snapshot.

kind.meaning: What sort of resource it is. Constraint: enum.

available.meaning: True when the host observed the resource at capture time.

quantity.meaning: Observed count for countable resources (for example 1 GPU). Null otherwise. Constraint: null or at least 0.

ref.meaning: Exact bytes of a supplied file or dataset. Null for hardware and services. Constraint: null or a Ref to immutable bytes.

item_id.meaning: Brief item being covered. Constraint: an ID in the Brief mandatory_requirements or deliverables.

item_kind.meaning: Whether the item is a mandatory requirement or a deliverable. Constraint: enum.

node_ids.meaning: Nodes that cover the item. The list is the exact inverse of the node tags. Constraint: 1 to 12 node IDs; each node must tag this item.

ref.meaning: The accepted artifact the scheduler handed to this port. Constraint: exact bytes of an accepted artifact.

node_id.meaning: Name of this node in the graph, for example `screening`. Never reused. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; unique in the plan.

cc.meaning: The one CC version this node runs. M1 binds one CC per node. Constraint: must match one library entry with selectable_by_planner true.

objective.meaning: One plain sentence on what this node does for the run. Constraint: 1 to 300 characters.

requirement_ids.meaning: Mandatory Brief requirements this node helps satisfy. Constraint: each an ID in the Brief mandatory_requirements; at most 40.

deliverable_ids.meaning: Brief deliverables this node produces or helps produce. Constraint: each an ID in the Brief deliverables; at most 20; requirement_ids and deliverable_ids together hold at least 1 item.

predecessors.meaning: Nodes that must be accepted before this node starts. Extra entries are ordering-only dependencies. Constraint: node IDs; at most 11; includes every future.producer_node of this node; no self reference.

inputs.meaning: Typed bindings for the node inputs. Constraint: at most 16 items; covers every required library input port.

outputs.meaning: Typed outputs the node will produce. Constraint: 1 to 16 items; covers every required library output port.

limits.meaning: Time, model-call and memory ceiling for one attempt of this node. Constraint: each value at most the library max_limits.

effect_class.meaning: Effect class of the pinned CC version. The scheduler uses it to decide what may run. Constraint: enum; copied from the library entry.

check_pins.meaning: Mandatory check bundle and checking profile for this node. Frozen. Constraint: copied from the library entry by the binder, never from the proposal.

extra_check_ids.meaning: Extra checks the binder adopted. Empty for a static template. Constraint: subset of the proposal suggested_checks; at most 8.

max_attempts.meaning: Attempts the scheduler may start for this node. Each attempt is a new dispatch record. M1 allows no automatic repair, so the value is 1. Constraint: 1 to 3; M1 plans use 1.

status.meaning: used if the connector answered, unavailable if it failed

citations_captured.meaning: Citations from this connector. 0 when unavailable

description.meaning: What an idea looks like at this score

name.meaning: Dimension name and score field name

match_terms.meaning: Lowercase phrases that always trigger the flag

check_id.meaning: Lowercase snake_case check name, unique in bundle

target_port.meaning: Output port of the target CC

reads.meaning: Records the runner may read. Each in output, inputs, runtime_records

question.meaning: Question answerable from declaration plus output

target_port.meaning: Output port of the target CC that this criterion is asked about. Null means the criterion is asked for every output of the CC. Constraint: null or an output port of the target CC.

result.meaning: pass only when json_print_calls is 1, metrics_key_found is true and missing_metric_ids is empty

json_print_calls.meaning: Number of print(json.dumps(...)) calls found by the AST scan of run_benchmark.py

metrics_key_found.meaning: True when a dict display with the string key metrics is the argument of that call

missing_metric_ids.meaning: Blueprint metric_id values that do not appear as string constants in the file. Empty when none are missing

node_id.meaning: A node of the frozen run plan whose attempt was accepted

gate_decision_ref.meaning: The gate decision with action advance that accepted that node attempt

check_id.meaning: The failing host check ID, for example acyclicity. Null for a Planner report or a gate halt

detail.meaning: Plain statement of what failed or what no CC can cover. 1 to 300 characters

input_directory_ref.meaning: Qualified configured input directory, including an empty authorized default directory

prior_plan_outcome_ref.meaning: Optional link to the plan_infeasible outcome that started this attempt. Null on a first attempt.

subnode_id.meaning: Subject/producing subnode; null for node aggregate records

observed_runtime.meaning: False only in synthetic teaching examples

subnode_id.meaning: Subject/producing subnode; null for node aggregate records

interfaces.name: node-execution-contract

id.meaning: Protected contract identity; changed bindings require new identity/revision

objective.meaning: Assigned product outcome, not a private CC task

requirement_ids.meaning: Accepted Brief or fixed-profile obligations this node must cover

inputs.meaning: Named external contract/version/requiredness and exact accepted references

outputs.meaning: Required external artifact meanings; compiler output is Research Brief

input_refs.meaning: Derived external input inventory, identical to named ports

evidence_obligations.meaning: Required observation/check/release evidence; missing data blocks

guard_profile_ref.meaning: Frozen independently owned node checking profile

policy_ref.meaning: Protected governing policy, not a producer readiness claim

template_ref.meaning: Frozen node template; no hash dependency on future child contracts

node_limits.meaning: Aggregate elapsed time/call/memory ceilings including separate verifier work

authority_ceiling.meaning: Maximum admitted read/write/tool/network effects; own future output reads follow frozen internal ports

subnodes.meaning: Pinned one-CC work/verifier assignments and prerequisites; no arbitrary composition

gate_assignments.meaning: Independent profiles for work boundaries and final aggregate acceptance

interfaces.failure: Unbound external inputs, cyclic internal dependencies, missing required subnodes/checks, excess authority or incomplete durable acceptance block node release.

interfaces.name: default-policy

hardware_profile.meaning: Authorized conservative default single_gpu; not observed hardware

interfaces.failure: Unknown, unavailable or unsupported default authority blocks the affected requirement; policy cannot invent purpose or claim hardware availability.

interfaces.name: selected-capsule-input

declaration.meaning: Complete parsed declaration; validate existing exact schema against original bytes

interfaces.failure: Missing, swapped, forged, changed, unsupported or ineligible input blocks; never choose another CC.

extra_requirements.meaning: Requirements only; no grant of tools or effects

fallback_model_id.meaning: At most one predetermined compatible API fallback

execution_id.meaning: One governed invocation routing idempotency key

input_refs.meaning: Same accepted inventory as the selected binding

model_selection_profile_ref.meaning: Protected immutable profile alongside the binding

interfaces.name: model-route

id.meaning: Persisted immutable routing decision identity; not group route_id

selected_capsule_ref.meaning: Exact exported CC and protected context

model_selection_profile_ref.meaning: Selection policy, distinct from guard profile

registry_snapshot_ref.meaning: Pinned API candidate snapshot; null for static baseline

limits.meaning: CC execution ceilings; separate routing overhead

fallback_used.meaning: Actual fallback path, not merely matching its ID

routing_context_ref.meaning: Pinned derived requirements/context with adapter revision

adapter_revision.meaning: Exact normalization adapter revision; not a model quality claim

environment_lock_ref.meaning: Equals the input lock and blueprint environment_ref

resource_refs.meaning: Equals blueprint resource_refs as a set

run_order.meaning: Execution order of roles. Length 2*repeat_count. All baseline before any treatment

metrics.meaning: Exactly one item per blueprint metric

raw_evidence_refs.meaning: Contains empirical_results_ref and every run stdout_ref and stderr_ref

empirical_results_ref.meaning: Parsed metric values of every run

network_allowlist.meaning: Allowed hosts. Empty when policy is none

unlisted_network_requests.meaning: Blocked requests outside the allowlist. 0 when succeeded

independent_variable.meaning: The one intervention the POC changes

validation_resource_ref.meaning: Fixed validation data, also in resource_refs

environment_ref.meaning: Prepared lock shared by both resource snapshots

outcome_rules.meaning: One pre-registered rule per declared metric

seed_policy.meaning: Same seed for baseline and treatment in every repeat

implementation_scope.meaning: Limits on what the Builder may write

constraints.meaning: Preserved constraints, contains every Brief constraint text

interfaces.failure: Missing resources, lock, declared metrics, disjoint numeric rules or conditional rule blocks Builder. Protocol cannot change after the host records the blueprint hash.

interfaces.name: poc-manifest

archive_ref.meaning: Bundle zip. sha256 equals the zip bytes hash

interfaces.failure: Missing file, wrong file name, unpinned dependency, bundle hash mismatch or lock mutation blocks. Builder runs no trial and installs nothing.

interfaces.name: build-receipt
interfaces.producer: host check bundle for the Builder (protected)

checker.meaning: Compile and import scan tool names and versions

forbidden_modules_ref.meaning: Forbidden-module list pinned in the check bundle

forbidden_scan_result.meaning: Import scan result across all .py files

output_format_check.meaning: Static check that run_benchmark.py writes the metrics output in the format Research Benchmark parses. No code runs. Constraint: see OutputFormatCheck.

dependencies_all_pinned.meaning: True only when every dependency has an exact version

trial_executed.meaning: Must be false. No POC code ran

packages_installed.meaning: Must be false. Nothing was installed

readiness.meaning: Mechanical readiness for Benchmark. READY only when every syntax result is pass or not_applicable, forbidden_scan_result is pass, output_format_check.result is pass and dependencies_all_pinned is true

readiness_reasons.meaning: Empty when READY, otherwise at least one reason

interfaces.failure: NOT_READY or a true trial_executed or packages_installed blocks Benchmark. Build evidence only, never measurements.

interfaces.name: poc-artifact-bundle

requirements_txt.meaning: Content of requirements.txt, exact pins only

poc_patch_py.meaning: Content of poc_patch.py, valid syntax, no forbidden import

run_benchmark_py.meaning: Content of the entry run_benchmark.py. Valid Python 3 syntax, no forbidden import. Runs the unmodified baseline or the patched treatment as the command line says, with the registered seed and validation data. Prints exactly one line print(json.dumps({"metrics": {<metric_id>: <number>}})) per invocation, one key per declared metric_id

interfaces.failure: Wrong entry set, unpinned requirement or forbidden import blocks Benchmark.

interfaces.name: plan-proposal

schema_version.meaning: Format version 3.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 3.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this proposal. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

brief_ref.meaning: Accepted governing Research Brief. Constraint: the accepted Brief given to the Planner.

library_snapshot_ref.meaning: Pinned list of eligible CC versions the nodes were chosen from. Constraint: the snapshot given to the Planner.

resource_inventory_ref.meaning: Pinned list of supplied and observed resources. Constraint: the snapshot given to the Planner.

policy_ref.meaning: Protected policy limits the plan was made under. Constraint: the plan policy given to the Planner.

mode.meaning: Marks a Planner-made plan. A static template carries `static` instead. Constraint: exactly planned.

nodes.meaning: The finite graph of nodes. Edges come from `predecessors` and future inputs. Constraint: 1 to 12 nodes (M1 ceiling, also limited by policy max_nodes).

coverage.meaning: Self-review map from each Brief item to the nodes that cover it. It is the exact inverse of the node tags. Constraint: 1 to 60 entries; one entry per mandatory requirement and per deliverable of the Brief.

topic_hints.meaning: Optional topic phrases for the Search scope. The binder copies them into search_scope.topic_hints. Search may ignore them. They grant nothing. Constraint: 0 to 5 items, each 3 to 100 characters, no duplicates.

limits.meaning: Aggregate ceiling for the whole plan. Constraint: time and calls at least the sum of node limits, memory at least the largest node limit, all at most the policy aggregate limits.

notes.meaning: Short planner remark for human review. It is not an instruction and grants nothing. Constraint: 0 to 1000 characters; the empty string is allowed only here.

interfaces.failure: Reject before dispatch for a failed binder check. A proposal grants no authority and no check relief.

interfaces.name: static-template

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 1.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this template. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

template_name.meaning: Name of the fixed path, for example `m1_research_path`. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$.

mode.meaning: Marks a hand-authored plan. Constraint: exactly static.

nodes.meaning: The fixed nodes. Same node shape as a plan proposal. Constraint: 1 to 12 nodes.

coverage.meaning: Self-review map from each Brief item to the nodes that cover it. It is the exact inverse of the node tags. Constraint: 1 to 60 entries; one entry per mandatory requirement and per deliverable of the Brief.

limits.meaning: Aggregate ceiling for the whole plan. Constraint: same rule as a plan proposal.

interfaces.failure: Reject before dispatch for a failed binder check. A template grants no authority.

interfaces.name: library-snapshot

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 1.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this snapshot. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

captured_at.meaning: When the library captured the snapshot. Constraint: UTC time, pattern YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

entries.meaning: Eligible CC versions. Active library changes after capture never alter this list. Constraint: 1 to 200 entries; the pair (cc_name, cc_version) is unique.

interfaces.failure: An entry with a null check pin is unusable. The binder rejects any node that names it.

interfaces.name: resource-inventory

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 1.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this snapshot. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

resources.meaning: Resources supplied by the user or observed on the host. Constraint: 0 to 100 items; resource_key unique.

interfaces.failure: A missing resource makes every node that needs it infeasible. The binder rejects the plan.

interfaces.name: plan-policy

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 1.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this policy. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

max_nodes.meaning: Most nodes a plan may hold. Constraint: 1 to 12.

allowed_effect_classes.meaning: Effect classes a node CC may have. M1 excludes `irreversible`. Constraint: 1 to 5 values from the effect class enum.

allow_network.meaning: When false, no node may use a CC whose `network_mode` is not `none`.

aggregate_limits.meaning: Ceiling for the whole plan. Time and calls add across nodes. Memory is the largest node value because M1 runs nodes one at a time. Constraint: positive; model_calls may be 0.

max_attempts_per_node.meaning: Ceiling for `max_attempts` of any node. Constraint: 1 to 3.

interfaces.failure: A plan outside the policy is rejected. The Planner cannot change the policy.

interfaces.name: run-plan

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 1.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this frozen plan. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

mode.meaning: `static` when built from a static template. `planned` when built from a Planner proposal. Both use this same type. Constraint: enum.

brief_ref.meaning: Brief the plan answers. Constraint: the accepted Brief.

library_snapshot_ref.meaning: Snapshot every CC pin was resolved against. Constraint: the pinned snapshot.

resource_inventory_ref.meaning: Resources the feasibility check used. Constraint: the pinned snapshot.

policy_ref.meaning: Plan policy the checks used. Constraint: the pinned policy.

configuration_ref.meaning: Effective run configuration. Constraint: the frozen run configuration.

source_ref.meaning: The unmodified source the binder started from. Constraint: a static template when mode is static, a plan proposal when mode is planned.

acceptance_ref.meaning: Committed acceptance of the bound plan. Dispatch cannot start without it. Constraint: a gate decision with action advance.

nodes.meaning: Bound nodes with resolved accepted refs and copied check pins. Constraint: 1 to 12 nodes.

topological_order.meaning: Dispatch order computed by the binder. M1 runs nodes one at a time in this order. Constraint: each node ID once; every node after all its predecessors.

limits.meaning: Aggregate ceiling for the whole plan. Constraint: same rule as a plan proposal.

frozen.meaning: Marks the plan immutable. After freeze there is no replan, substitution or pin change. Constraint: must be true.

interfaces.failure: A missing acceptance record, an unresolved accepted ref or a missing pin blocks dispatch. Nothing in a frozen run plan may change.

interfaces.name: dispatch-record

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly 1.0.0.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this record. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$.

run_plan_ref.meaning: Plan the dispatch belongs to. Constraint: the frozen run plan of this run.

node_id.meaning: Node dispatched. Constraint: pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$; a node of the run plan.

cc.meaning: CC version that ran. Constraint: equal to the run plan node cc.

bound_input_refs.meaning: Exact accepted artifacts passed in. Constraint: one per node input that was bound; names unique; at most 16.

check_pins.meaning: Check bundle and profile that applied. Constraint: equal to the run plan node check_pins.

check_plan_ref.meaning: Bound check plan built for this attempt. Constraint: a bound check plan.

attempt.meaning: Attempt number. A new attempt is a new record. Constraint: 1 to the node max_attempts.

started_at.meaning: Dispatch start time. Constraint: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

ended_at.meaning: End time. Constraint: null only for outcome interrupted; otherwise UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

outcome.meaning: How the attempt ended. `accepted`: the gate accepted the outputs. `rejected`: checks or verifier did not pass. `halted`: protected stop. `failed`: execution or infrastructure error. `budget_exhausted`: a limit was hit. `interrupted`: the process ended before a decision. Constraint: enum.

gate_decision_ref.meaning: Gate decision for this attempt. Constraint: null only for outcomes failed, budget_exhausted and interrupted.

output_refs.meaning: Accepted outputs. Rejected output stays in evidence, not here. Constraint: non-empty only for outcome accepted; at most 16.

elapsed_s.meaning: Observed wall time in seconds. Constraint: null or at least 0.

model_calls_used.meaning: Observed model calls, null when unobserved. Constraint: null or at least 0.

interfaces.failure: A record that names a node, pin or input not in the run plan is rejected and the dispatch is blocked. Records are append-only.

interfaces.name: search-scope
interfaces.producer: Protected binder (from run configuration, resource inventory and Planner topic hints)

connectors.meaning: Permitted connectors. Each from the connector enum, no duplicates. Anything not listed is forbidden

max_queries.meaning: Most queries Search may write and run

max_hits_per_query.meaning: Most sources one external connector may contribute per query

local_document_refs.meaning: User local documents Search may read. Non-empty when local_documents is permitted

topic_hints.meaning: Optional topic phrases from the Planner. Search may use them when it writes queries. Empty in static mode. 0 to 5 items, each 3 to 100 characters, no duplicates

interfaces.failure: A scope that fails its structure check blocks the Search dispatch. Search writes its own queries inside these bounds.

interfaces.name: candidate-set

scope_ref.meaning: Bound search_scope whose bounds Search ran under

queries.meaning: The queries Search itself wrote and ran, in run order. 1 to max_queries items, each 3 to 200 characters, no duplicates. Every citation query is one of them

connector_outcomes.meaning: One row per permitted connector, including failures

ideas.meaning: One to three grounded ideas, each citing at least one citation

interfaces.failure: Wrong idea count, uncited idea, unresolved citation, excerpt mismatch or queries outside the scope bounds reject. No evidence from any connector halts. An unavailable connector is recorded, never filled with an invented hit.

interfaces.name: screening-rubric
interfaces.producer: CC owner (pinned in the Screening declaration)

tie_rule.meaning: Equal totals rank the lower idea_id first

forbidden_dependencies.meaning: Dependencies that make an idea ineligible

interfaces.failure: A rubric hash that differs from the pin halts Screening. RSI never changes the rubric.

interfaces.name: screening-result

scores.meaning: Exactly one row per candidate idea

ranking.meaning: Selected and eligible ideas by total descending then idea_id ascending

interfaces.failure: Missing, duplicate or out-of-range scores, wrong totals or order reject. No eligible idea halts with no_eligible_idea.

interfaces.name: opportunity-card

idea_id.meaning: Selected idea. Equals screening_result.selected_idea_id and exists in the candidate set

summary.meaning: Purpose of the card: what is tested and why

scores.meaning: Original scores of the selected idea, unchanged

constraints.meaning: Verbatim text of every Brief constraint and mandatory requirement

other_dispositions.meaning: One row per non-selected candidate idea

interfaces.failure: A selected idea outside the candidate set, a mismatch with the screening result, a lost constraint or a missing disposition rejects.

interfaces.name: check-bundle

checks.meaning: Deterministic checks. Must include a blocking <port>_schema check per output port

interfaces.failure: Missing blocking schema check per output port, or unpinned bundle on an admitted CC version, rejects admission and binding

interfaces.name: checking-profile

criteria.meaning: Must include the three generic criteria, blocking

interfaces.failure: Any criterion with answerable_from other than declaration_and_output, or a missing generic criterion, rejects admission

interfaces.name: review-context

contract_ref.meaning: Exact checked node or subnode execution contract; scope is explicit

subnode_id.meaning: Subject/producing subnode; null for node aggregate records

interfaces.failure: Host-only audit record. It is never part of the verifier model payload. A missing or mismatched manifest blocks the gate.

interfaces.name: gate-decision-index
interfaces.producer: Scheduler (host record built from accepted dispatch records)

run_plan_ref.meaning: The frozen run plan of this run

entries.meaning: One entry per node whose gate advanced before Delivery started, in run plan topological order. Node IDs unique

interfaces.failure: A missing or unresolved entry blocks Delivery dispatch. Delivery never builds the index itself.

interfaces.name: plan-outcome

outcome.meaning: The recorded halt outcome. plan_infeasible is the only value in M1

trigger.meaning: What made the plan infeasible: the binder or a proposal check rejected the proposal or template, the plan gate did not advance, or the Planner reported that no listed CC can cover the Brief

brief_ref.meaning: The accepted Brief the plan was meant to answer. It is carried to the next Intention Compiler attempt

source_ref.meaning: The rejected plan proposal or static template. Null only when the Planner reported infeasibility and produced no graph

check_result_ref.meaning: The deterministic check result that carries the failing check. Null when no check ran

gate_decision_ref.meaning: The plan gate decision, when a gate decided. Null otherwise

reasons.meaning: Why the plan is infeasible. Carried to the next attempt. 1 to 20 items

attempt_depth.meaning: Position of this plan attempt in the chain of linked Intention Compiler attempts for one request. The first plan attempt is 1. M1 default limit is 2

next_stage.meaning: Where the host sends the request next

linked_attempt_id.meaning: ID of the new Intention Compiler attempt the host started from this outcome. Null when attempt_depth has reached the limit and the host halts for a human

interfaces.failure: A plan_infeasible outcome without reasons, or one that lets the same run continue, is invalid. The run halts and nothing is repaired inside it.
